overrides.rationale: Phase 1 project walk tuning; donor serialized base speed is 2 m/s and still requires repeated runtime comparison before parity can be claimed.
Standing eye height is now aligned with the exact donor camera anchor while posture remains project-owned.
Gravity magnitude is aligned with donor serialized CharacterMotor data; integration remains a project-owned CharacterController implementation.
Traversal capsule height/radius/step now match exact donor serialization; crouch changes the view/head-clearance rig instead of widening or collapsing the physical capsule.
